title: JUKI AMS-210EN HL 1306 SZZ
subtitle: Computer-Controlled Cycle Machine for Heavy-Weight Materials

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI AMS-210EN HL 1306 SZZ is a computer-controlled cycle sewing machine designed to automatically sew pre-programmed stitch patterns on garments and textile products. It replaces manual pattern sewing with precise, repeatable automated cycles, dramatically increasing production speed and consistency.
applications: Sewing pocket openings, flap attachments, and welt pockets on trousers, jackets, and uniforms
Attaching labels, patches, and emblems to garments
Sewing belt loops, waistbands, and reinforcement stitching on heavy-weight denim and workwear
Tacking and securing straps on bags, backpacks, and military gear
Any application requiring a fixed, repeatable stitch pattern on medium-to-heavy fabrics
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, workwear production, military and uniform manufacturing, bag and accessory production

overviewDescription: The JUKI AMS-210EN HL 1306 SZZ is a high-speed, computer-controlled cycle sewing system manufactured by JUKI Corporation. The "EN" series signifies "Energy-saving" and "Next-generation" architecture, featuring a main-shaft direct-drive system and advanced electronic control. This specific configuration is optimized for medium-to-heavy weight materials and features a pneumatic material clamping system.

classificationTable.value: Computer-controlled Cycle Machine with Input Function

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Direct-Drive Mechanism
workingPrinciples.description: The machine utilizes a 550W AC servomotor mounted directly to the main shaft. This eliminates belt-slip and provides instantaneous acceleration and deceleration, reducing machine time per cycle.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Encoder-Controlled Feed
workingPrinciples.description: Unlike standard stepping motors, the EN series uses an encoder-control system. It continuously monitors the position of the X and Y feed tables. If heavy material resistance is detected, the system increases power to the stepping motors to prevent "lost steps" or pattern deformation.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Active Tension
workingPrinciples.description: The needle thread tension is electronically controlled on a stitch-by-stitch basis. This allows for pinpoint changes in tension to accommodate varying material thicknesses (e.g., crossing a seam) or changes in sewing direction.

workingPrinciples.heading: 4. Programmable Intermediate Presser
workingPrinciples.description: To prevent "flagging" (fabric lifting with the needle), the lower dead point of the intermediate presser can be adjusted steplessly via the operation panel.

finalNotes:
• Lubrication: Use only JUKI New Defrix Oil No.2 (ISO VG32 equivalent) for the hook and JUKI Grease A/B for the frame.
• Safety: Switching on the machine is only possible when the hand is clear of moving sections; ensure the "sensor handle" is functioning on compliant versions.
• Speed Handling: For thick threads (#2 to #8), the 7300 subclass with slide-type thread take-up is required to maintain stitch stability at high speeds.
